name: Parcel Delivery Damage
text: Parcels delivered with visible damage are triaged based on packaging vs item impact. If the contents or item inside is damaged or broken, a full refund is approved immediately under Clause 4.1. If only the outer cardboard packaging or box is damaged with a damage ratio at or below 30% and contents remain intact, packaging replacement or a repackaging credit is issued under Clause 4.2. Outer packaging damage exceeding 30% qualifies for item replacement under Clause 4.3. Any claim with order value exceeding $200.00 requires mandatory human specialist handoff under Clause 8.2. Minimum decision confidence required is 0.70 under Clause 9.1.

clauses.refund: Clause 4.1: Direct item/contents damage confirmed by visual inspection qualifies for immediate customer refund.
clauses.replace_packaging: Clause 4.2: Minor superficial packaging damage (<=30% surface area) with intact contents qualifies for packaging replacement or store credit.
clauses.replace_item: Clause 4.3: Severe packaging deformation (>30% surface area) posing risk of concealed damage qualifies for item replacement.
clauses.handoff_high_value: Clause 8.2: High-value orders exceeding $200.00 threshold must be routed to human review.
clauses.handoff_uncertain: Clause 9.1: Insufficient visual confidence (<70%) or missing product boundaries requires human specialist escalation.
